endorsements.quote: AI-generated cases, images, feedback, questions, and assessment materials should undergo subject-matter expert review and, where used for formal assessment, appropriate psychometric evaluation before implementation.

Finally, institutions should adopt a staged implementation strategy, beginning with locally evaluated pilot programs that examine educational effectiveness, feasibility, acceptability, safety, cost, and transfer to practice before broader institutional or national scale-up.

Synthetic images should be clearly identified as synthetic and validated for educational fidelity before being used to teach pathology or image interpretation.
A three-arm design - conventional preparation, non-AI virtual simulation, and AI-enhanced virtual simulation - would be more informative than comparing AI simulation only with usual teaching.

unlisted_practices: Implement AI-enhanced simulation in education as an adjunct to, not a replacement for, physical skills laboratory teaching and supervised clinical education.
Describe the technology used with precision and avoid attributing benefits shown for virtual reality or conventional simulation to AI without AI-specific evidence.
Keep final progression, readiness, and high-stakes assessment decisions under accountable human assessors rather than AI.
Define resource constraints at the level of the educational program rather than assuming all institutions in a country face the same limitations.
Conduct local needs assessment at each participating program before implementing AI-enhanced simulation.
Safeguard equitable access, including shared computer laboratories, mobile-compatible platforms, offline functionality, multilingual content, and accessibility for students with disabilities.
Compare total cost of ownership, including licensing, hardware, faculty training, support, and maintenance, with demonstrated educational benefit during procurement.
Ensure lawful data access, de-identification, permissions, and secure storage when patient-derived images or cases are used in AI education tools.
Document model version, prompts or task specifications, review procedures, data handling, and mechanisms for identifying erroneous outputs in educational AI use.

screen.reason: Commentary proposing a framework and discussing implementation considerations/safeguards for AI-enhanced virtual simulation in radiography education within resource-constrained settings.
